description: Before you accept or pay a stage: CAPPZ checks the delivered file against the milestone’s agreed acceptance criteria and returns a signed pass / fail / needs-human verdict. The file goes to the evaluator only (not the public log) and is not kept. Costs 0.05 XRP from your wallet. The contract’s named evaluator can accept on a pass with --accept. Moves money: on mainnet pass yes=true only after the person you act for agrees.

accept.description: You are the contract’s named evaluator: on a pass with the agreed criteria, accept the stage citing the verdict (the buyer still pays).

acceptance.description: Only when the contract has no agreed criteria for the stage: your own (the verdict says they came from you).

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

file.description: The delivered file (its SHA-256 must be the seller’s published evidence).

milestone.description: Stage index (default: the stage with new evidence).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

name: market_evaluate
